def solve_epoch(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds,
                value, W):
    ep = Plan(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds, value, W)
    ep.build_arcs()
    ep.build_aux()
    idx = ep.ratio_search()
    ratio = ep.rset[idx]
    low = ep.lowers(ratio)
    ep.set_lowers(low)
    ep.optimise(low)
    if not ep.potentials(low):
        ep.pot = [0] * ep.K
    cut = None
    if ratio < 1:
        cut = ep.cut_for(idx)
    ok = False
    try:
        ok = ep.verify(ratio, low, cut)
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    return ep, ratio, cut, ok
